title: Most news algorithms are designed to keep you scrolling, not to keep you informed.
body:
It is a subtle but important distinction. When an app optimizes purely for engagement, it tends to serve you the most shocking or divisive headlines because those trigger quick reactions. We took a different approach at Headlinne.

Our recommendation engine does not track how long you stare at a headline or how often you click a link. Instead, it looks at the topics you actually read through to the end. It learns your genuine interests over time, not your knee-jerk reactions. If you read deeply about climate policy or local tech startups, the engine prioritizes those subjects, not the viral outrage of the day.

We believe technology should work for the reader, not the advertiser. By focusing on relevance rather than rage, we can help you cut through the noise and find the stories that actually matter to your life. It is not about knowing everything. It is about knowing what is worth your time.
cta: You can see how we are building a better way to read at HEADLINNE.com.
